findings.title: Embedded post author link color is inverted relative to the intended light/dark mapping
findings.body: `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` was previously `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new value is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. Since the first argument is the light-theme value, this changes the light-theme link color and uses the inverse of the 30/70 mapping used for other 30% primary values. The result can be poor contrast and inconsistent styling.

findings.title: Mobile custom-message-length color changes the light-theme value and differs from desktop
findings.body: `.custom-message-length` was previously `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. The mobile rule now uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, while the desktop equivalent uses 70% primary for the light theme and 30% secondary for the dark theme. This changes the light-theme appearance and is inconsistent with the stated dark-theme correction.

This appears to be a copy/paste error, reducing heading hierarchy in light themes and not applying the intended dark-theme mapping.
